notes: Values are transcribed from the JINA standard-temperature tables and are validation data, not an independent experimental evaluation.
The gl12 literature table shown by JINA contains comparison points only through T9=3; the JINA fit interface also displays calculated standard points through T9=10.
High-temperature use in an engineered plasma remains a model extrapolation question even when the REACLIB implementation is reproduced exactly.
